remaining_limitations: The deterministic tiny-Llama fixture uses random weights and validates transport and engine execution only, not semantic accuracy.
Production reasoning-model weights and benchmark data were unavailable, so production semantic accuracy and throughput remain unverified.
NVIDIA, quantized, biased, TP>1, speculative-decode, and unsupported model-architecture paths were not qualified.
No native source changed; the installed AITER module was exercised and no native rebuild was applicable.
